name: Marcelo Buosi
profile: Co-founder and COO of QI Tech, the Brazilian banking/credit-as-a-service infrastructure unicorn founded in 2018. Before that he worked with Pedro Mac Dowell at credit fund manager Quatá Investimentos in operations and fund management; QI Tech grew out of Quatá's own infrastructure needs.
interesting_fact: QI Tech reports R$494B in Pix transactions, R$107B+ in credit issued and R$190B+ under management.
deep_cut_fact: An economist from USP's FEA, he started out in the economics department of Barclays Bank before joining Quatá Investimentos.

name: Ramakrishna Kasturi
current_role: AVP, Company Secretary, Legal Affairs and Compliance Officer, Aragen Life Sciences
profile: Company secretary and compliance officer of Aragen Life Sciences (formerly GVK Biosciences), the Hyderabad-based CRDMO preparing for an IPO. He is listed among senior management; he is not a founder in Aragen's own materials (Hurun's founder tag likely comes from shareholder lists).
deep_cut_fact: He holds a master's degree in commerce from Osmania University.
notes: Low-profile corporate officer; Hurun 'founder' label appears inaccurate.

name: Puneet Jain
current_role: Co-founder, MD and CIO, Neo Asset Management (Neo Group)
profile: Co-founded Neo Group in 2021 and serves as CIO of its asset-management arm (private credit, equities, real assets). Previously an Executive Director in equity research at Goldman Sachs (India consumer and real estate) and earlier at Kotak Institutional Equities.
interesting_fact: Neo Group, which he co-founded in 2021, reached unicorn status in 2026 and reports about Rs 1.3 lakh crore of client assets.
deep_cut_fact: An IIT Kanpur graduate, he was a portfolio manager listed as co-founder & CIO of Neo Alternative Asset Managers after 19+ years at Goldman Sachs and Kotak Institutional Equities.
notes: Common name; ensure not confused with other Puneet Jains.

name: Esteban Castano
profile: Co-founded TRM Labs, a blockchain intelligence company whose tools help law enforcement, governments and financial institutions trace crypto crime, now expanding into AI-enabled crime investigation (Ardence platform). He has led TRM through rapid global expansion and a $1B+ valuation.
interesting_fact: He withdrew from Stanford Graduate School of Business to co-found TRM.
deep_cut_fact: Before TRM and McKinsey digital work, he worked at Generation, the nonprofit focused on global youth employment; he holds a BA in Government from Dartmouth.
notes: TRM press center offers interview requests with executives via press@trmlabs.com.
